review: Score manually or via agent review against inspected code. Keep this review outside the published handoff. Formatting validation does not prove semantics.

automatic_fail: Exposed secrets or real personal data

rubric.1: Mostly right, but an important step is missing.
rubric.2: Purpose and direction clearly identify producer, consumer, input, and output.

rubric.0: Invalid JSON, fictional interface, or misleading fields.
rubric.2: Valid representative golden path, consistent with evidence and labeled assumptions.

rubric.0: Important transformations are missing or wrong.
rubric.1: Main mapping is right but incomplete.
rubric.2: Meaningful renames, derived, dropped, and ambiguous fields are clear; obvious passthroughs are omitted, or explicitly no non-obvious mappings.

rubric.0: Missing rules or claims contradict the code.
rubric.2: Short actionable rules cover relevant failures, trust boundaries, assumptions, and open decisions.

rubric.0: An engineer cannot start from it.
rubric.2: A junior engineer can see what to send, expect, and confirm in the five sections.

reproduction_review.scope: Optional kit review only; preserve the five-section rubric and keep all scores outside slice handoffs.
checks: Score each selected slice separately; an overall score must not hide a failed access boundary.
Include golden and relevant negative cases: different viewer/tenant, denied or empty data, invalid input, and tool failure.
Distinguish actual access enforcement from UI hiding; no system-wide security inference.
Attribute tested model/version/settings, prompts/scripts/tools, harness-supplied behavior, and mocked steps; uncaptured facts stay Unknown.
Tie consequential observations and benchmark results to sanitized evidence; distinguish recommendations, assumptions, and causal claims.
Port deterministic mappings and decision gates; re-evaluate candidate model/harness against properties, not exact generated prose.
Record benchmark scope, case set, thresholds, per-slice scores, failures, and exclusions outside handoffs; formatting success is not reproduction success.

cards.setup: POST receives display_name, trims it into name, drops debug, and returns a created record. Code rejects blank names.
must_capture: Blank-name rejection; error shape unknown if not shown

cards.setup: Tool result items is an array. Agent derives summary. Tool errors can produce no summary.
Worker receives event_id and amount_cents, derives amount by dividing by 100, and emits a result event. No deduplication code is shown.
must_capture: amount_cents → amount with units and division

cards.setup: Only a function accepting text and returning generated text exists; no transport, validation, or wire format is established.
must_capture: Incomplete validation reported without fictional JSON

cards.setup: Input has email, access_token, and message; serializer returns derived preview only. Logs and retention are not inspected.
must_capture: email and access_token dropped at this output boundary
cards.sensitive_data: Never reproduce source credentials or real personal data; use unmistakably synthetic values.
